dedupe_keys.name: texture2lod3 enabling lod3 building reconstruction with panoramic images

description: Wenzhao Tang, Weihang Li and Olaf Wysocki publish Texture2LoD3 data for reconstructing detailed urban facades from panoramic images. The Zenodo record describes CityGML geometry and GeoJSON building footprints, semantically segmented WallSurface OBJ files, Google Street View panoramas, facade ground-truth masks and derived textures. Native TUM2TWIN documentation links this release to street-level imagery and the campus digital twin. The selected record was published on 10 April 2025 and identifies open access under CC BY 4.0. Access is free through its dataset landing. Exact component extents and image acquisition dates were not established, so coverage is recorded as the documented campus environment without assuming every file covers Munich. Caveats include mixed geometric and image components and uncertain rights inherited from upstream panoramas. Its metadata DOI points to an arXiv publication; that identifier is not used as the dataset deduplication key. The native Zenodo record establishes dataset identity. It supports facade geometry and texture preparation for a building digital twin and relates to the existing TUM2TWIN benchmark. No images or masks were retrieved.
